placements.copy_context: Wide letterbox band for The Gap section of the MSS homepage. Replaces gap-anchor.png, a 3:4 macro whose 3:1 crop read as visibly zoomed and too thick. Composed for a wide band rather than cropped from a portrait: three matte board slabs in a low horizontal line, camera far back and near surface level, generous empty ground. Three offset forms in near-black, terracotta and pale sand are the logo mark's geometry.

assets.notes: 6048x2592, 21:9, quality high, seed from job f0f97eb4. Chosen from three variants. Production crop lives at website/site/src/assets/gap-anchor-wide.png: crop=6048:1008:0:798 scaled to 3000x500 (6:1), which centres the slab band with air above and ground below. Astro re-encodes to responsive WebP from there. Rejected: job 1d684144 (slab band sat too high, one slab ran out of frame), job 6139b866 (hallucinated a trade-show background with people, purple signage and lettering, all three explicitly excluded in the brief).
